notes: Graduate output = students who successfully completed the programme between 1 January and 31 December of the reference year; completion is by the effective date of the degree (chapter introduction, PDF page 1).
2024 figures in Table 4.1 are marked provisional (footnote 1).
'page' is the PDF page within Chapter 4.pdf (1-16); printed report page numbers are in 'printedPage(s)'. The page-2 summary has no table number, so its 'table' is null.

Rows are long format: one row per institution x field (x year for 4.1, x level for 4.3). 'female' and 'total' are the printed F and T values. null = cell printed blank; 0 = printed as 0 (summary 'Dental Science' was printed '-' and is stored as 0 with printedAs '-'). Cells blank on both F and T are left out unless a footnote marker sits on them (then both are null and 'footnotes' explains, e.g. 9 = no output in the year, 7 = information not submitted).
Uva Wellassa University (letter U) is printed with Total 0 / 0 in both years and footnote (7) 'Information not submitted': these 0s mean no data, not zero graduates.

University of Colombo 2024: Management & Commerce, Law and Technology carry footnote (7) 'Information not submitted' and are blank, so its 2024 total (1700) and the 2024 Law and Management & Commerce national totals are incomplete.
Eastern University (H) in 4.1 is reported separately from Trincomalee Campus (W) and Swamy Vipulananda Institue of Aesthetic Studies (Y); the letters follow that split.

Table 4.1 has no Education column. The page-2 summary shows Education 438 (F 410); the Open University (4.3) reports 216 (F 215) Bachelor Education graduates, so by arithmetic the other 222 (F 195) sit inside the Arts column of Table 4.1 (summary Arts 11,729 + Education 438 = 4.1 Arts 7,507 + 4.3 Arts 572 + 4.3 Education 216 + 4.4 Arts 3,872). This is an inference from the totals; the report does not say which institution.

Reconciliation, all exact: in Table 4.1 every institution's fields sum to its printed Total (F and T, both years) and every field column sums to the printed Total row; Tables 4.3 and 4.4 rows and columns sum to their printed totals; page-2 summary total 33,290 = 4.1 (23,790) + 4.3 Bachelor (3,028) + 4.4 (6,472). Per field, summary Science 4,129 = 4.1 Science 3,561 + 4.4 Science 116 + 4.3 Science/IT 452, and summary Computer Science 1,510 = 4.1 Computer Science/IT 1,194 + 4.4 Computer Sc./IT 316.

Not extracted (this file covers undergraduate output): Table 04 - 02 postgraduate output by HEI (PDF pages 7-13), the postgraduate half of page 2, Chart - 12 (page 6) and Chart - 13 (page 14). Table 4.3 is included whole (all levels) because it is one small table; filter on level = 'Bachelor Degree' for undergraduates.
Institution names are kept exactly as printed, including the report's spellings 'Insitute of Human Resource Advancement' and 'Swamy Vipulananda Institue of Aesthetic Studies'.
No FindMyWay letter (not in data/ugc/2025-2026/unicodes.csv): Insitute of Human Resource Advancement; Institute for Agro Technology and Rural Sciences; The Open University. Their 'letter' is null.
